name: put in something that turns out not to matter
one_line: One thing placed where somebody will look, attractive enough to be picked up and inert enough to produce nothing.
how: Take a form that already works and add one item that leads nowhere: a fourth measurement in a table of three that are used, an object named in the room that opens nothing, a date on the page that no question asks about. Make it useless rather than false — a false item sends somebody to a wrong conclusion and costs them everything they did, a useless one costs them the ten seconds of deciding. Never announce it. A line saying «not everything here is needed» makes discarding the exercise instead of solving it, which is a different afternoon. One is enough.

knobs.effect: useless wastes time and is recoverable; false leads to a wrong answer and throws away the work done to reach it. They share a name and are not the same object.
undeclared, the task is to solve; declared, the task becomes to discard, and the person reads looking for what to throw away rather than for what is there.
too dull and nobody picks it up, so it did nothing; too central and it stops being an aside and becomes the afternoon.
the same effect is available by making something else more interesting instead of adding an item. It costs no paper and cannot be mistaken for a mistake.

where_the_work_is: In deciding what is relevant, which is the operation this adds and the only one it adds. A page where every item is used can be solved by counting the items, and somebody who notices that stops reading.
breaks: It produces nothing that can come back on a sheet, so it can never be the point of a moment — only an addition to one. Used more than once in an afternoon it stops being an aside and reads as the page being untrustworthy, which is a different and worse feeling.
